ability.name: Slow
ability.notes: Slowed condition approximates halved Speed, AC and Dexterity penalties, action restriction, and no Reactions.

ability.name: Sleet Storm
ability.notes: Area obscurity, difficult terrain, doused flames, and concentration loss are approximated or omitted.

ability.name: Sorcerous Burst
ability.notes: Damage type is chosen; exploding d8 damage is approximated and omitted.

ability.name: Sleep
ability.notes: Second failed save causes unconsciousness, approximated as repeated incapacitation.

ability.name: Spider Climb
ability.notes: Grants climbing and ceiling movement; not represented as a combat mechanic.

ability.name: Spike Growth
ability.notes: Difficult terrain and camouflage are approximated; recurring damage triggers when creatures move 5 feet in the area.

ability.name: Stone Shape
ability.notes: Shapes stone; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Spirit Guardians
ability.notes: Radiant damage assumes good or neutral caster; evil casters deal necrotic damage instead.

ability.name: Stinking Cloud
ability.notes: Poisoned condition approximates inability to take actions or bonus actions while in the cloud.

ability.name: Telepathic Bond
ability.notes: Creates long-range telepathic communication; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Suggestion
ability.notes: Charmed target follows the suggested course of activity; completion may end the effect early.

ability.name: Sunbeam
ability.notes: Creates a new 60-foot line as an action each turn; sunlight illumination has no combat effect.

ability.name: Starry Wisp
ability.notes: Outlined approximates emitting light and preventing benefits from invisibility.

ability.name: Teleportation Circle
ability.notes: Creates a temporary portal to a known permanent teleportation circle; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Thaumaturgy
ability.notes: Minor sensory effects and Intimidation advantage are not meaningfully represented in combat.

ability.name: Sunburst
ability.notes: Also dispels magical darkness in the area.

ability.name: Thunderwave
ability.notes: Push effect and unsecured object interaction are omitted.

ability.name: Storm of Vengeance
ability.notes: Later turns vary: lightning, hail, cold, deafening, obscured terrain, and weapon ranged attacks are approximated.

ability.name: Telekinesis
ability.notes: Object manipulation and movement are approximated as single-target control.

ability.name: Teleport
ability.notes: Primarily transports creatures; destination mishaps are not modeled.

ability.name: Tiny Hut
ability.notes: Protective shelter with no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Summon Dragon
ability.notes: Summons a dragon spirit with Rend, Breath Weapon, resistances, and shared chosen resistance.

ability.name: Tongues
ability.notes: Grants universal language comprehension and communication; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Transport via Plants
ability.notes: Creates a temporary plant-to-plant portal; no direct combat effect.

ability.name: Tree Stride
ability.notes: Provides specialized tree teleportation and movement; not meaningfully represented in simple combat.

ability.name: Symbol
ability.notes: Represents Death glyph; other glyph effects and delayed triggering are omitted.

ability.name: True Seeing
ability.notes: Grants truesight, which is not represented as a combat effect.

ability.name: True Resurrection
ability.notes: Restores a dead creature to full hit points; resurrection, restoration, and body replacement are not modeled.

ability.name: Time Stop
ability.notes: Grants 1d4+1 consecutive turns, which this schema cannot represent.

ability.name: Unseen Servant
ability.notes: Creates a mindless servant for simple tasks; it cannot attack.

ability.name: True Strike
ability.notes: Makes one weapon attack; weapon damage and attack range depend on the weapon used.

ability.name: True Polymorph
ability.notes: Transformation and temporary hit points are approximated; full-hour concentration can make the effect permanent.

ability.name: Vitriolic Sphere
ability.notes: Failed saves take 5d4 acid damage at the end of the target's next turn.

ability.name: Vicious Mockery
ability.notes: Disadvantage on the target's next attack is not directly representable.

ability.name: Wall of Force
ability.notes: Creates an impassable invisible barrier; wall geometry and forced repositioning are approximated.

ability.name: Wall of Fire
ability.notes: Approximates the wall as a 60-foot line; recurring damage represents the selected side and entry or end-turn triggers.

ability.name: Vampiric Touch
ability.notes: Healing equals half necrotic damage dealt and cannot be represented precisely.

ability.name: Water Breathing
ability.notes: Grants underwater breathing; no meaningful combat effect.

ability.name: Water Walk
ability.notes: Allows chosen creatures to move across liquid surfaces; no meaningful combat effect modeled.

ability.name: Tsunami
ability.notes: Wall dimensions and decreasing later-round damage are approximated as a 300-foot cube with recurring 5d10 damage.

ability.name: Warding Bond
ability.notes: Damage sharing with the caster is not represented; resistance, AC, and saving throw bonuses are captured.

ability.name: Wall of Thorns
ability.notes: Approximates the wall as a 60-foot line; recurring damage applies when entering or ending a turn in it.

ability.name: Wall of Stone
ability.notes: Creates a configurable stone barrier; Dexterity save only applies to creatures enclosed by the wall.

ability.name: Wall of Ice
ability.notes: Recurring damage represents passing through a breached wall; wall shape, object durability, and push are approximated.

ability.name: Web
ability.notes: Recurring entry/start saves and Athletics escape approximated; flammable webs' conditional fire damage omitted.

ability.name: Weird
ability.notes: Targets re-save at end of each turn; failed saves deal recurring psychic damage, successful saves end the spell.

ability.name: Wind Wall
ability.notes: Captures initial damage and saving throw; ongoing projectile deflection and movement barrier are approximated.

ability.name: Word of Recall
ability.notes: Teleports willing creatures to a prepared sanctuary; treated as utility outside combat.

ability.name: Wind Walk
ability.notes: Flight, hover, prone immunity, and action restriction are not fully represented.

ability.name: Wish
ability.notes: Choice-dependent spell duplication and reality alteration are not represented.

ability.name: Zone of Truth
ability.notes: Truth restriction is approximated as a recurring Charisma save without a listed condition.
